notes.title: PARSE v1.3 | Gameplay Update!
notes.notes:
[b]Gameplay update[/b], but rather a [i]"step by step"[/i] mode of the game.

[h1]Important[/h1]
[list]
[*]System improvement of weapons and items gathering!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30525612/db1034941b615dd1ce71ff62425d6bdc47faac73.png[/img]

[*]With enemies will now drop items with which you can improve your weapons.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30525612/589fbaac667dfc57e04b2d759e34f2478b356989.png[/img][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30525612/aa8de85c98fb223b9347ca6fa7d52612fd5cb32e.png[/img]

[*]The map will now appear turrets, the damage of which depends on their number.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30525612/e2df29390491609f4b722f7f2bd7508730ad22bc.png[/img]
[/list]

[h1]Less important[/h1]
[list]
[*]The fog of war is now more complex logic.
[*]Fixed a balance between the destruction of the buildings and their restoration.
[*]Superior part of the graphics component.
[*]Increased the chance to spawn of the Agoran 1%.
[/list]
